summary: Moleculin Biotech filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to increase its at-the-market (ATM) offering capacity under an existing agreement with Roth Capital Partners from $8.2 million to $19.7 million in aggregate gross sales price. The filing is a routine shelf takedown and ATM size increase, not a special situation. It reports 486,775 shares previously sold for approximately $1.89 million. No premium, tender, or strategic event is involved. The company remains listed on Nasdaq under MBRX, and sales are subject to Form S-3 General Instruction I.B.6 float limits. Watch future ATM sales for dilution.
